reason: The Pixel development source and GPS broadcast ephemeris cover GPS L5_Q, but the current smartphone adapter and SPP model cannot safely use L1/L5 as independent measurements. GPS L5 is a secondary SPP signal used only by the generic IFLC path, which has no GPS L5 ISC/code-bias state in the local navigation model. No experimental flag or solver output was published; this is a fail-closed audit record and no holdout data was opened.

navigation_audit.signal_bias_coverage: The local GPS broadcast records expose the legacy single delay field only; no GPS L5 ISC_L5Q/ISC_L5I or equivalent signal-specific correction is present in the local navigation parser/data. No smartphone GPS L5 OSB/DCB product is supplied to this route.

rinex_audit.current_adapter_status: not enabled; SIGNAL_CONTRACTS and StreamingRinexWriter publish GPS_L1_CA and optional GAL_E1_C_P only
rinex_audit.required_writer_change: A safe candidate would need per-satellite L1 and L5 fields in one GPS RINEX observation row, rather than the current one-selected-frequency tuple.

native_solver_audit.dual_frequency_policy: When use_ionosphere_free_combination=true, validateObservations groups one satellite's observations and emits at most one SPPObservation; GPS_L5 is a secondary signal, not an independent measurement.
native_solver_audit.group_delay_model: src/algorithms/spp.cpp groupDelayCorrectionMeters returns eph.tgd for GPS regardless of GPS_L1CA/GPS_L5; the IFLC combination therefore has no L5-specific ISC term.
native_solver_audit.navigation_parser_model: src/io/rinex.cpp stores the GPS broadcast delay in eph.tgd and leaves eph.tgd_secondary at 0.0 for GPS; no GPS L5 ISC field is decoded.
native_solver_audit.code_bias_model: biasObservationCode can name GPS_L5 as C5Q for an external DCB/SSR lookup, but this smartphone route supplies no such product and that does not add a broadcast L5 ISC state.
native_solver_audit.inter_system_bias: The existing receiver clock grouping can model GPS versus other constellations, but it does not model a GPS L1/L5 signal-specific receiver/code bias.
native_solver_audit.quality_weighting: The existing SPP variance model receives RINEX S/CN0; RawPseudorangeUncertaintyMeters is not propagated by the current adapter/RINEX/SPP interface.
missing_model: GPS L5 Q code/ISC correction provenance (CNAV or validated DCB/OSB)
a per-frequency observation/ionosphere/bias state or a validated L1/L5 IFLC contract
an adapter/RINEX representation that preserves paired L1 and L5 observations and their quality fields

comparison.candidate_execution: not-run; fail-closed model audit blocked an unsafe experiment

promotion_gate.required: Only after the missing L5 bias/multi-frequency model is implemented: all major accuracy, availability, and four local Kaggle diagnostic metrics must improve against the promoted Galileo E1 development baseline.

implementation_status: No GPS L5 experimental code was added. Revisit only after signal-specific bias provenance and a multi-frequency SPP contract are available; then rerun development 600/full before any holdout use.
